title: doz space file (space/3)
description: One workspace in one YAML file (NAME.space.yaml): its agents, rooms, folders, sandboxes, services and secrets, each **owned** (the space makes it) or **external** (it exists already; external: says so), plus what carries over between runs (persist:) and the evidence down writes (archive:).
markdownDescription: One workspace in one YAML file (`NAME.space.yaml`): its agents, rooms, folders, sandboxes, services and secrets, each **owned** (the space makes it) or **external** (it exists already; `external:` says so), plus what carries over between runs (`persist:`) and the evidence `down` writes (`archive:`).

^x-.description: Ignored by doz; for other tools (diagram layouts, dashboards).
^x-.markdownDescription: Ignored by doz; for other tools (diagram layouts, dashboards).

doz.description: The format of this file. Always space/3.
doz.markdownDescription: The format of this file. Always `space/3`.

space.description: The space's name: the SPACE part of every full name it owns (doz://HOST/SPACE/TYPE/NAME), and the workspace record's name. Unique on the Mac.
space.markdownDescription: The space's name: the SPACE part of every full name it owns (`doz://HOST/SPACE/TYPE/NAME`), and the workspace record's name. Unique on the Mac.

title.description: A display title for the dashboard.
title.markdownDescription: A display title for the dashboard.

brief.description: Path to the brief (relative to this file), which says what the work is for. Copied into each run's archive.
brief.markdownDescription: Path to the brief (relative to this file), which says what the work is for. Copied into each run's archive.

owner.description: The deciding human. Must be the Mac's Dozable owner. Written in the space file, never inherited.
owner.markdownDescription: The deciding human. Must be the Mac's Dozable owner. Written in the space file, never inherited.

permissions.description: The default permission preset for this space's agents, by name. Presets are held by Dozable.
permissions.markdownDescription: The default permission preset for this space's agents, by name. Presets are held by Dozable.

trusted_folders.description: Folders outside the owner's home that trust: before may apply to.
trusted_folders.markdownDescription: Folders outside the owner's home that `trust: before` may apply to.

folders.description: Folders: name: definition. External (external: PATH) or owned ({}: a scratch folder made inside the run folder).
folders.markdownDescription: Folders: `name: definition`. External (`external: PATH`) or owned (`{}`: a scratch folder made inside the run folder).

agents.description: Agents: name: definition. External (a bot or an adopted session) or owned (Dozable starts it).
agents.markdownDescription: Agents: `name: definition`. External (a bot or an adopted session) or owned (Dozable starts it).

services.description: Services: name: definition. Dozable has no services yet; until it does, plan refuses an owned service.
services.markdownDescription: Services: `name: definition`. Dozable has no services yet; until it does, `plan` refuses an owned service.

secrets.description: Secrets: name: definition. Always external; delivered to agents as placeholders.
secrets.markdownDescription: Secrets: `name: definition`. Always external; delivered to agents as placeholders.

rooms.description: Rooms: name: definition. An owned room lasts one run unless persist: names it.
rooms.markdownDescription: Rooms: `name: definition`. An owned room lasts one run unless `persist:` names it.

external.description: An existing agent: a full name, { bot: NAME } or { session: NAME }. With it, only role, labels and profiles may be given.
external.markdownDescription: An existing agent: a full name, `{ bot: NAME }` or `{ session: NAME }`. With it, only `role`, `labels` and `profiles` may be given.

bot.description: A registered Dozable bot, by its name.
bot.markdownDescription: A registered Dozable bot, by its name.

session.description: An adopted @mac session, by its record's name.
session.markdownDescription: An adopted `@mac` session, by its record's name.

folder.description: The working folder: a name from folders.
folder.markdownDescription: The working folder: a name from `folders`.

prompt.description: The first prompt. Dozable prepends the run line and the agent's own full name.
prompt.markdownDescription: The first prompt. Dozable prepends the run line and the agent's own full name.

prompt_file.description: The first prompt, from a file (relative to this file).
prompt_file.markdownDescription: The first prompt, from a file (relative to this file).

requests.description: Asks the owner for a role or grants; grants nothing by itself.
requests.markdownDescription: Asks the owner for a role or grants; grants nothing by itself.

role.description: A role that carries power, such as admin.
role.markdownDescription: A role that carries power, such as `admin`.

grants.description: Grants asked for, e.g. network: api.github.com.

role.description: What it does in this space. At most one manager. Roles that carry power (admin) are requested under requests, not given.
role.markdownDescription: What it does in this space. At most one manager. Roles that carry power (admin) are requested under `requests`, not given.

isolation.description: For where: mac. Default fenced. Must be written on the agent itself when permissions: bypass. In a sandbox, the VM is the boundary.
isolation.markdownDescription: For `where: mac`. Default `fenced`. Must be written on the agent itself when `permissions: bypass`. In a sandbox, the VM is the boundary.

permissions.description: A preset held by Dozable, by name. Default: the space's permissions, else the owner's default.
permissions.markdownDescription: A preset held by Dozable, by name. Default: the space's `permissions`, else the owner's default.

secrets.description: Names from secrets. Delivered as placeholders; the proxy swaps in the value.
secrets.markdownDescription: Names from `secrets`. Delivered as placeholders; the proxy swaps in the value.

remote_control.description: Turn on Remote Control for the session.
remote_control.markdownDescription: Turn on Remote Control for the session.

chat.description: How it gets messages, and its extra rooms. Every worker is always in the main room.
chat.markdownDescription: How it gets messages, and its extra rooms. Every worker is always in the main room.

delivery.description: inbox (messages arrive in the session) or poll (dozchat listen).
delivery.markdownDescription: `inbox` (messages arrive in the session) or `poll` (`dozchat listen`).

rooms.description: Rooms (names or full names) besides the main room.
rooms.markdownDescription: Rooms (names or full names) besides the main room.

transcripts.description: What happens to its Claude transcripts at down. Default by case: memory persisted, always keep; archive on, discard after the archived copy is hash-checked; archive: off, keep.
transcripts.markdownDescription: What happens to its Claude transcripts at `down`. Default by case: memory persisted, always `keep`; archive on, `discard` after the archived copy is hash-checked; `archive: off`, `keep`.

resume.description: summary: when its memory isn't persisted, start it with a summary of the last run, from the archive.
resume.markdownDescription: `summary`: when its memory isn't persisted, start it with a summary of the last run, from the archive.

approvals.description: Overrides the space's approvals for this agent.
approvals.markdownDescription: Overrides the space's `approvals` for this agent.

agent_defaults.description: Keys applied to every owned agent unless the agent sets them: any agent key except prompt, prompt_file, folder, requests and isolation: unfenced (an agent is never unfenced by inheritance).
agent_defaults.markdownDescription: Keys applied to every owned agent unless the agent sets them: any agent key except `prompt`, `prompt_file`, `folder`, `requests` and `isolation: unfenced` (an agent is never unfenced by inheritance).

isolation.description: Only fenced: an agent is never unfenced by inheritance. Each unfenced agent writes isolation: unfenced itself.
isolation.markdownDescription: Only `fenced`: an agent is never unfenced by inheritance. Each unfenced agent writes `isolation: unfenced` itself.

approvals.description: Who decides, and how. Approvals point at policies Dozable holds; the file does not define them. A room message is never an approval.
approvals.markdownDescription: Who decides, and how. Approvals point at policies Dozable holds; the file does not define them. A room message is never an approval.

deciders.description: Who answers Asks: owner, or agent names.
deciders.markdownDescription: Who answers Asks: `owner`, or agent names.

via.description: ask: anything outside the agent's grants becomes an Ask to the deciders.
via.markdownDescription: `ask`: anything outside the agent's grants becomes an Ask to the deciders.

archive.description: The evidence down writes, and where. On by default; off turns it off.
archive.markdownDescription: The evidence `down` writes, and where. On by default; `off` turns it off.

anyOf.description: No archive at all. The plan summary says so.
anyOf.markdownDescription: No archive at all. The plan summary says so.

to.description: Where runs are archived. Default ~/Library/Application Support/doz/spaces/{space}/runs/{run}. An owner-chosen folder is allowed if no agent of the space can write it.
to.markdownDescription: Where runs are archived. Default `~/Library/Application Support/doz/spaces/{space}/runs/{run}`. An owner-chosen folder is allowed if no agent of the space can write it.

keep.description: What to keep (default: all). manifest and timesheet are written whenever the archive is on.
keep.markdownDescription: What to keep (default: all). `manifest` and `timesheet` are written whenever the archive is on.

extends.description: A defaults file, or a list applied in order. Paths are relative to this file; ~ is the home folder.
extends.markdownDescription: A defaults file, or a list applied in order. Paths are relative to this file; `~` is the home folder.

external.description: An existing folder, by path. Never made, moved or removed.
external.markdownDescription: An existing folder, by path. Never made, moved or removed.

access.description: rw (default) or ro, for agents that use it.
access.markdownDescription: `rw` (default) or `ro`, for agents that use it.

trust.description: before: record folder trust at up (only under the owner's home or trusted_folders).
trust.markdownDescription: `before`: record folder trust at `up` (only under the owner's home or `trusted_folders`).

optional.description: External only: a missing folder is skipped instead of stopping up.
optional.markdownDescription: External only: a missing folder is skipped instead of stopping `up`.

labels.description: Free string metadata, kept in the manifest and timesheet (client: acme, billable: "true").
labels.markdownDescription: Free string metadata, kept in the manifest and timesheet (`client: acme`, `billable: "true"`).

name.description: A name: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and -.
name.markdownDescription: A name: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and `-`.

persist.description: What carries over between runs; nothing else does. A map of named entries, each naming one owned thing: { room: NAME }, { sandbox: NAME }, { agent: NAME } or { folder: PATH }. null removes an inherited entry. {space} is the space's name and "*" every owned agent.
persist.markdownDescription: What carries over between runs; nothing else does. A map of named entries, each naming one owned thing: `{ room: NAME }`, `{ sandbox: NAME }`, `{ agent: NAME }` or `{ folder: PATH }`. `null` removes an inherited entry. `{space}` is the space's name and `"*"` every owned agent.

room.description: An owned room in chat.rooms: kept with its history and id; closed between runs.
room.markdownDescription: An owned room in `chat.rooms`: kept with its history and id; `closed` between runs.

sandbox.description: An owned sandbox: its disk is kept, with the VM shut down.
sandbox.markdownDescription: An owned sandbox: its disk is kept, with the VM shut down.

agent.description: An owned agent: its Claude conversations and memory; the next run starts it with --continue. "*" is every owned agent.
agent.markdownDescription: An owned agent: its Claude conversations and memory; the next run starts it with `--continue`. `"*"` is every owned agent.

folder.description: A data folder, kept as it is; made on the first up if missing.
folder.markdownDescription: A data folder, kept as it is; made on the first `up` if missing.

preset.description: A permission preset held by Dozable, by name: standard, auto, bypass, or one the owner defined.
preset.markdownDescription: A permission preset held by Dozable, by name: `standard`, `auto`, `bypass`, or one the owner defined.

profiles.description: Included only with up --profile NAME, e.g. [review].

external.description: An existing room: a full name, true (same name, no space) or its name. Only its messages during the run window are archived.
external.markdownDescription: An existing room: a full name, `true` (same name, no space) or its name. Only its messages during the run window are archived.

members.description: owner and agent names (short or full). Owned rooms gain them at up; external rooms get missing ones invited.
members.markdownDescription: `owner` and agent names (short or full). Owned rooms gain them at `up`; external rooms get missing ones invited.

main.description: true on the main room. Default: the room named like the space, else the first owned room.
main.markdownDescription: `true` on the main room. Default: the room named like the space, else the first owned room.

external.description: An existing sandbox: a full name, true (same name) or its name.
external.markdownDescription: An existing sandbox: a full name, `true` (same name) or its name.

folder.description: A name from folders, shared into the VM as /workspace.
folder.markdownDescription: A name from `folders`, shared into the VM as `/workspace`.

external.description: Always external: { keychain: ITEM } or { file: PATH }. The value is never read into the plan.
external.markdownDescription: Always external: `{ keychain: ITEM }` or `{ file: PATH }`. The value is never read into the plan.

keychain.description: A macOS keychain item, by name.
keychain.markdownDescription: A macOS keychain item, by name.

to.description: HOST[:PORT]: the only destination where the proxy swaps the placeholder for the value.
to.markdownDescription: `HOST[:PORT]`: the only destination where the proxy swaps the placeholder for the value.

external.description: An existing service: a full name, { url: http://… } or { session: NAME }.
external.markdownDescription: An existing service: a full name, `{ url: http://… }` or `{ session: NAME }`.

url.description: A URL on this Mac that answers.
url.markdownDescription: A URL on this Mac that answers.

session.description: A running session, by its record's name.
session.markdownDescription: A running session, by its record's name.

folder.description: Where to run it: a name from folders.
folder.markdownDescription: Where to run it: a name from `folders`.

ports.description: Reserved for the run. up refuses a port already in use.
ports.markdownDescription: Reserved for the run. `up` refuses a port already in use.

health.description: { http: URL }, { tcp: PORT } or { command: … }, with interval and timeout. up waits for it.
health.markdownDescription: `{ http: URL }`, `{ tcp: PORT }` or `{ command: … }`, with `interval` and `timeout`. `up` waits for it.

http.description: A URL that answers when it is up.
http.markdownDescription: A URL that answers when it is up.

tcp.description: A port that accepts connections when it is up.
tcp.markdownDescription: A port that accepts connections when it is up.

command.description: A command that exits 0 when it is up.
command.markdownDescription: A command that exits 0 when it is up.

interval.description: How often to check: seconds, or a duration like 5s.
interval.markdownDescription: How often to check: seconds, or a duration like `5s`.

timeout.description: How long up waits: seconds, or a duration like 2m.
timeout.markdownDescription: How long `up` waits: seconds, or a duration like `2m`.
